_comment: FX-LINK-01: work-item link crawler. Vectors marked executed ran against verbatim-extracted function bodies (probe /tmp/fx_webhooks_probe.py + /tmp/fx_probe2.py; DNS and requests.* mocked). Source: bgtasks/work_item_link_task.py:24-273. Unit oracle: pi_dash/tests/unit/bg_tasks/test_work_item_link_task.py (126 lines) — its cases are folded into safe_get_matrix.

error_shape.favicon_url_key: ABSENT on this path (only title/favicon/url keys)

ok_shape.title: <stripped <title> text or None when fetch failed/tag missing>

rules: browser UA header (Chrome/91 on Win10) on the title fetch
title fetch failure (RequestException OR ValueError/RuntimeError) only warns; title stays None and favicon still attempted
favicon resolved against final_url (post-redirect) so relative hrefs resolve correctly
outer broad except -> log_exception + error shape (transcribed; the error SHAPE above is exact)

default_favicon.data_uri: data:image/svg+xml;base64,<DEFAULT_FAVICON> (note svg+xml CONTENT TYPE here; fetched favicons use their response content-type instead)

fetch_and_encode.exception: ANY exception (incl. safe_get ValueError on a private favicon URL) -> logger.warning + DEFAULT data-uri with favicon_url None
fetch_and_encode.found: safe_get(favicon_url, headers); content_type = headers.get('content-type', 'image/x-icon'); data-uri = f'data:{ct};base64,{b64(content)}'
fetch_and_encode.missing: find returns None -> {'favicon_url': None, 'favicon_base64': DEFAULT data-uri}

find_favicon.fallback: HEAD {scheme}://{netloc}/favicon.ico (allow_redirects=False, timeout=2); return it ONLY on status 200; non-200 -> None; RequestException -> log_exception(warning) + None
find_favicon.link_tag: selectors tried in order: link[rel=icon], link[rel='shortcut icon'], link[rel=apple-touch-icon], link[rel='apple-touch-icon-precomposed']; first tag WITH href wins; href resolved with urljoin(base_url); then validate_url_ip — a PRIVATE href raises ValueError OUT of find_favicon_url (no guard on this branch; executed)

vectors.private_href: ValueError: Access to private/internal networks is not allowed

metadata_before_after.after: <crawl result dict> (golden ok_shape above; error path shape on outer failure)
metadata_before_after.write: issue_link.metadata = meta_data; issue_link.save() — full save(), no update_fields

safe_get_matrix.loop: RuntimeError('Too many redirects for URL: <original url>') once a 6th redirect response arrives (redirect_count >= 5 checked per hop; 5 redirects + final 200 SUCCEEDS — unit test pins this)
safe_get_matrix.missing_location: redirect response with NO Location header -> break, returns (redirect_response, current_url) AS-IS (transcribed; no test covers it)
safe_get_matrix.plain: 1 GET, allow_redirects=False, timeout=1 (default); returns (response, url unchanged)
safe_get_matrix.redirect: each hop re-validated AFTER urljoin (relative Location resolved); returns (final_response, final_url after 1 hop: https://example.com/next); requests.get called with allow_redirects=False every hop
safe_get_matrix.redirect_target_private: ValueError from per-hop validate_url_ip propagates (evil.com -> 302 to 169.254.169.254 blocked)

task.missing_link: IssueLink.DoesNotExist -> logger.warning('IssueLink not found for the id <id> and the url <url>') + return (no raise)
task.name: crawl_work_item_link_title(id, url)
task.order: crawl FIRST (network), DB lookup SECOND — a dead link still pays for the crawl

validate_url_ip_matrix.order: scheme check FIRST (file:///etc/passwd has no hostname; scheme error reported, not 'no hostname')

vectors.ftp_scheme: ValueError: Invalid URL scheme. Only HTTP and HTTPS are allowed
vectors.loopback: ValueError: Access to private/internal networks is not allowed
vectors.no_hostname: ValueError: Invalid URL: No hostname found
vectors.private_ip: ValueError: Access to private/internal networks is not allowed
vectors.scheme_file: ValueError: Invalid URL scheme. Only HTTP and HTTPS are allowed
vectors.unresolvable: ValueError: Hostname could not be resolved

validate_url_ip_rule: urlparse; scheme must be http/https; hostname required; socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None) (gaierror -> unresolvable; empty list -> 'No IP addresses found'); EVERY resolved addr checked: ip.is_private OR is_loopback OR is_reserved OR is_link_local -> deny (note: is_multicast/is_unspecified NOT checked — port as-is)
